what: Who was elected to each House seat and each Senate seat at the start of each term from 1989-1990 to 1997-1998 (and 1999-2000, for measuring only), read from the Manual for the General Court's general-election returns and its page of the sitting Senate. Every row keeps its edition, its line in that edition's text and the line as printed.
source: Manual for the General Court (the State's, Internet Archive OCR text, data/manuals)
mid_term_changes_not_shown: An edition is printed at the start of a term. It shows who was elected and who sat at the start, not a seat that changed hands by death, resignation or special election later in the term; nobody who took a seat after the start is in this table.
